models_evaluated: Epic Systems Risk of Pediatric Asthma Exacerbation model

links.outcome: Asthma hospitalizations, ED visits, and oral steroid courses within 90 days after model implementation versus control
links.effect: Adjusted difference-in-differences: hospitalization -0.9% (95% CI -1.6 to -0.3), ED visit -2.4% (-3.9 to -0.8), oral steroid -1.9% (-4.3 to 0.5, not significant).
links.quote: This EHR vendor model implementation was associated with a significant decrease in asthma hospitalization and ED visits within 90 days of pediatric allergy and pulmonology clinic visits, but not oral steroid courses.

unlisted_practices: Noninterruptive risk score displayed in the patient schedule view for volunteer providers

screen.reason: Empirical evaluation of the real-world clinical implementation of an EHR vendor predictive model (Epic Systems Risk of Pediatric Asthma Exacerbation) displayed non-interruptively in clinician schedules, using a difference-in-differences design and qualitative interviews.
